what_differs: The primary and secondary buttons on one screen have a larger corner radius (12 px) than on the other screens (6 px).
The page title and content on one screen start 8 px further right (48 px from the sidebar instead of 40 px) and the content is 16 px narrower (960 px instead of 976 px).
The page title and section headings on one screen are smaller (title 28 px instead of 34 px, headings 18 px instead of 22 px); body text is unchanged.
The accent color on one screen is a teal (#16897d) instead of the indigo (#4a46c8) used on every other screen.
The icons on one screen (navigation and cards) are filled solid shapes; on the other screens they are outlined line icons.
The navigation is a top bar on one screen, while it is a left sidebar on every other screen.
The navigation item for projects is labeled Workspaces on one screen and Projects on every other screen.
